Dein Hauptfokus liegt auf der operativen und strategischen Skalierung unseres Werbekanals SEA (Google Ads + Microsoft Ads)

  • Du verantwortest unsere Werbe-Accounts und entwickelst die Kampagnenstruktur für lokale und deutschlandweite Nachfrage weiter.

Du arbeitest hands-on in den Accounts, stimmst dich strategisch direkt mit unserem Head of Marketing ab und steuerst das Budget ROI-getrieben.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen, damit klar ist, welche Anfragen wirklich zu den Aufträgen führen welche wir wünschen.

Ihr Profil

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Ads und hast Accounts mit relevantem Budget selbst verantwortet, inhouse oder in einer Agentur.
  • Du kennst Lead-Generierung aus der Praxis und weißt, warum ein günstiger Lead nicht automatisch ein guter Lead ist.
  • Du bist sicher in Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen und Smart Bidding.
  • Du setzt Tracking selbst auf und findest Fehler selbst: Google Tag oder Tag Manager, GA4, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions.
  • Du hast schon Offline-Conversion

title: Operations Process & Systems Manager
description:
As Operations Process & Systems Manager, you will take full ownership of the systems our Operations team runs on and the processes that connect them, so every pergola we sell moves smoothly from purchase order to delivered order and after-sales. You’ll bring structure and clarity: owning our WMS, ERP and OMS, documenting how we work across markets, and partnering with internal tech, external vendors and our AI specialist to remove manual work at scale. This role is based in our Frankfurt office and requires regular visits to our warehouse in Fulda. As a premium outdoor-living brand inspired by Scandinavian design, PERGOLUX offers the opportunity to build the operational backbone of a fast-growing company active in 14 countries.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as business owner for our Operations systems (WMS, ERP, OMS) and their integrations with e-commerce, carrier and CRM platforms.

  • Gather requirements, prioritise changes and work with internal tech and external vendors to deliver them, from design and testing through training and go-live.

  • Map, design and document end-to-end operational processes across supply chain, warehousing, fulfilment and customer service.

  • Write and maintain SOPs, and make sure teams across all markets actually use them.

  • Identify and remove manual work, partnering with our AI specialist on automation opportunities.

  • Keep master data and system configuration clean and consistent across markets.

  • Serve as the go-to person when a process or system issue cuts across teams.

What You’ll Bring

title: Account Executive
description:
At Almetra, we’re on a mission to reinvent how factories work.

We help manufacturers - one of the most essential and overlooked sectors of our economy - run better. Every car, wind turbine, medical device, and washing machine comes from a factory. But factories today are running out of people. They struggle with efficiency, safety, and quality - and they desperately need better tools to understand what’s happening on the shop floor.

That’s where we come in. Almetra builds AI-powered computer vision systems that give manufacturers deep visibility into how their production lines actually run - and the insights to improve them. We don’t sell ads or marketing software. We help real factories solve real problems.

You’ll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from an early-stage startup into a category-defining company.

Why join us

  • Mission with real impact. You’ll help the world’s most essential companies stay competitive, sustainable, and safe in a world of labor shortages and rising costs.

  • Category-defining moment. With global manufacturers already deploying Almetra and fresh funding, we’re scaling fast across Europe and the US.

  • Big deals, big influence. You’ll lead 6-digit enterprise sales cycles, shape our go-to-market motion, and be a core driver of our revenue engine.

  • High bar, high trust. You’ll work directly with founders, product, and engineering to design solutions and expand strategic accounts.

What you’ll do

  • Run full-cycle

title: Sales Manager - DACH (Steel Trading, B2B)
description:
About Vanilla Steel

Vanilla Steel is a B2B steel trading company based in Berlin. We combine industrial metal trading across Europe with the proprietary software our own traders use to make transactions faster and more transparent than traditional phone and spreadsheet processes.

Your mission

We’re looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Sales Manager to own and grow our steel trading business in the DACH region. Your core mission is to grow regional P&L by sourcing, negotiating, and executing profitable B2B steel trading transactions while building long-term relationships with suppliers and buyers.

This role blends B2B sales, account management, trading, and business development and plays a key part in scaling Vanilla Steel’s commercial footprint across Europe

Your role

You will drive sales across the DACH region, managing the full trading lifecycle from suppliers to buyers while utilizing our internal platform.

  • Own and grow Vanilla Steel’s steel trading & brokerage activity in the DACH region

  • Act as the main point of contact for German-speaking buyers and suppliers

  • Source, negotiate, and close profitable steel trading deals

  • Manage the full deal lifecycle: pricing, contracts, coordination with operations & logistics

  • Proactively identify and approach new customers via cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and meetings

  • Develop and manage your own customer portfolio

  • Maintain clean documentation in our CRM (HubSpot) and internal systems

  • Analyze trading and sales performance to improve margins and scalability

  • Share market insights, pricing trends, and customer feedback with the team

  • Collaborate with our product and engineering teams to feed market insights back into our trading software

Requirements

  • Professional background in B2B sales, account management

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

title: Market Product Lead
description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

description: 职位描述    核心工作职责    客服体系搭建与流程标准化：结合快递行业规范，制定本地化客服SOP、咨询分级、投诉处理时效、理赔标准、退换货流程。  服务标准管理： 建立并优化客服服务标准、话术规范及服务流程，推动集团客服标准在西班牙本地落地执行。  核心指标管理与优化：监控并优化呼叫中心接通率、接听率、平均处理时长（AHT）、首次解决率（FCR）、投诉率、客户满意度（CSAT）等，通过数据分析推动服务效率和质量提升。  投诉与理赔管理： 建立标准化的投诉、理赔及异常件处理流程，确保客户问题及时处理并形成闭环。  合规管理： 确保客服业务符合GDPR及当地相关法规要求，规范客户信息保护及业务记录管理，确保数据可追溯。  系统管理： 负责客服工单系统、呼叫中心及在线客服平台的日常管理，并提出系统优化需求。  客诉分析与协同： 定期分析客户投诉原因，输出客诉报告，协同转运、干线及末端网点推动问题整改。       职位要求    西班牙语听说读写流利，英语商务沟通流利，具备中文沟通能力优先。  本科及以上学历，物流管理、市场营销、语言学、客户服务管理等相关专业优先。  具备5年及以上快递或物流相关行业客服经验，有客服团队0-1搭建阶段经验者优先。  熟悉呼叫中心运营模式及管理方法，具备客服流程、管理制度及指标体系的搭建或优化经验。  具备较强的投诉处理、沟通协调及应急管理能力，能够适应高投诉量、高压的工作环境。          Job Description    Key Responsibilities    Customer Service System Development and Process Standardization: Develop localized customer service SOPs in line with industry standards, covering inquiry classification, complaint handling timelines, compensation policies, and returns and exchanges procedures.  Service Standards Management: Establish and optimize customer service standards, communication scripts, and service procedures, ensuring the effective implementation of the Group’s customer service standards in Spain.  KPI Management and Optimization: Monitor and optimize key call center KPIs, including call connection rate, call answer rate, average handling time (AHT), first contact resolution (FCR), complaint rate, and customer satisfaction (CSAT). Use data analysis to improve service efficiency and quality.  Complaint and Compensation Management: Establish standardized processes for handling customer complaints, compensation claims, and shipment exceptions, ensuring timely resolution and proper follow-up.  Compliance Management: Ensure customer service operations comply with GDPR and applicable local regulations. Maintain appropriate customer data protection practices and business records to ensure traceability.  System Management: Oversee the daily operation of customer service ticketing systems, call center systems, and online customer service

Du willst etwas erreichen? Dann mach.

smava ist Deutschlands Online-Kreditvergleich — wir machen Kredite transparent, fair und günstig. Für unsere Kreditberatung suchen wir Teammitglieder, die Bock haben, mit starker Beratung echte Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Dein Einsatz? Wird nicht gebremst, sondern belohnt. Mit ungedeckelter Provision.

Verstärke unser Sales Teamab sofort in Vollzeit als:

Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Homeoffice - deutschlandweit (w/m/d)

Das machst du bei uns

  • Du berätst unsere Kund*innen telefonisch (Outbound) und schriftlich zu ihrem Kreditvergleich — von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum Vertragsabschluss (warme Leads).
  • Mit einer gezielten Bedarfsanalyse erkennst du, was deine Kund*innen wirklich brauchen — und lieferst das optimale Kreditangebot.
  • Durch deine erstklassige Beratung nutzt du jedes Gespräch, um Up- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale zu erkennen und umzusetzen.
  • Deine Kundengespräche dokumentierst du sauber im CRM — die Grundlage für einen erfolgreichen Kreditantrag und für deine Abschlüsse.

Das bist du

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der vertriebsorientierten Beratung (z. B. Telesales, B2C-Vertrieb oder ähnliche Positionen).
  • Sales ist deine Leidenschaft — Bedarfsanalyse, Einwandbehandlung, Up- und Cross-Selling sind dein Daily Business und treiben dich an, erfolgreich zu sein.
  • Du bist KPI-driven, trackst deine Zahlen über Dashboards und weißt immer, wo du stehst.
  • Am Telefon überzeugst du mit Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit — ein erstes Nein bringt dich nicht von deinen Zielen ab.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Sales-Tools — CRM-Systeme sind dir nicht fremd.
  • Feedback und regelmäßige Side-by-Sides

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. Global objectives:

  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activiti

Wir zeigen Unternehmen, was in ihnen steckt, und setzen dieses Potenzial in die Tat um. Was uns jeden Tag motiviert? Zu sehen, wie unsere Arbeit das Leben tausender Menschen erleichtert.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

  • Assist customers with payment-related queries and issue resolution.

  • Create and optimise email templates, knowledge articles, and customer communication campaigns.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation.

  • Test new workflows and automation solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Accounting, Sales, Customer Service, and Tech teams.<

title: Regional Director - Enterprise
description:
Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas. Too often, they move at the speed of the systems they run on.

Behind every process change or new product line sits an SAP landscape shaped by decades of custom code and complexity. Changes take months. Migrations can cost more than $100 million and take years.

Conduct is building the AI operating system that makes this complexity understandable and actionable, so enterprises can move faster and pursue bigger ambitions. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We have secured partnerships with systems integrators and raised a $60 million Series A. Demand is outpacing our capacity to deliver.

The Role

Your opportunity is to win new ground for Conduct, land its most important customers, and build the team that makes it happen, inside a company in hyper-growth.

As Regional Director, Enterprise, you will recruit, develop and lead a high-performing sales team focused on winning Conduct's most strategic new enterprise accounts and bringing a new kind of technology to market. You will own recruitment, enablement and sales execution across your territory, building pipeline and coaching Enterprise Account Executives through complex buying processes.

The challenge is to build a team that earns the trust of major enterprises on decisions that matter to their business, and turns that trust into consistent wins. You will set the standard for how that team hires, develops and sells.

title: Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Join our Customer Success team, where you will focus on driving SaaS revenue growth through proactive customer engagement. While leveraging data insights, you will proactively identify upsell opportunities and mitigate churn risks. Your strategic guidance and deep product knowledge will be essential in helping customers unlock new value of our product and set them up for success.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Drive customer engagement - through building and nurturing value-creating and scalable relationships, you develop a deep understanding of your clients’ and their finance goals. You guide and consult with them in order to drive their engagement and the activation of all the spend management features.

  • Upsell - you leverage your deep understanding of both the product and your customer's needs to identify new business opportunities, as well as product and feature optimisation initiatives to increase value for existing accounts. 

  • Measure success and provide data insights - with the use of specific KPIs you aim to achieve and monitor revenue trajectory through, for example, key metrics such as spend engage

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Working closely with executive stakeholders, you will lead strategic opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, helping customers leverage explainable AI, intelligent investigation workflows, and emerging agentic AI capabilities to improve detection, reduce false positives, and increase operational efficiency.

title: Stage - Assistant(e) Campaign Manager (H/F)
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Campaign Manager pour rejoindre notre équipe CRM à l’occasion d’un stage d’une durée de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe CRM, vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • La création et la gestion de nos campagnes CRM omnicanales (Newsletters, SMS, Push notifications, communications in-app et WhatsApp) ;
  • L’analyse, le monitoring et l’optimisation des KPIs CRM au global ;
  • Le benchmark et la veille concurrentielle des meilleures pratiques du marché ;
  • L’excellence opérationnelle, notamment dans la coordination intra et inter-équipes.

Détail des missions: 

1. Gestion du Run & des campagnes automatisées

  • Plan d'animation commercial : déploiement et programmation des campagnes ponctue

Based in Berlin, you will be the person who ensures marketing decisions are grounded in accurate data, and you will help answer where the next Euro of media spend should go to maximise revenue, margin, and efficiency. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Overview

In August 2024, Allica Bank entered the bridging finance market with the acquisition of Tuscan Capital where its highly experienced team has been retained to help build a specialist division with the ambition to become a market leader in the bridging finance sector, leveraging our proven success in commercial mortgages and asset finance.

To support this growth, we are expanding our team into the regional areas to meet the increasing demands of the intermediary market.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Building and relationship managing a portfolio of bridging finance Introducers in the South, with responsibility for day-to-day management of the relationships.

  • Originating, structuring, and progressing bridging applications from Introducers and Borrowers, from initial enquiry through to completion.

  • Managing a team of three Business Development Managers within the South region.

  • Attending industry events, conferences, and networking functions to promote the company’s brand and identify new opportunities for collaboration.

Department Description

Allica Cashflow Finance delivers lending to meet the funding needs of growing established, profitable businesses who do not have tangible collateral available to offer in support.

Our growing team of specialists share a common focus on structuring funding solutions for those clients and delivering an exceptional relationship experience.

During the origination process, we gain a deep understanding of each business. This informs both facility structuring and risk management as well as providing the foundation of our ongoing relationship.

Role Description

The Cashflow Finance RM Associate will be responsible for supporting and assisting the Relationship Management team with the onboarding and administration of new and existing clients.

In addition to the service and relationship aspects, the role will also assist with maintaining up to date internal reporting and general day to day activities on the portfolio required to run the client’s facilities effectively
